candidates.title: A Correct Answer Does Not Mean the Work Is Complete
candidates.title_zh: 答案正确，不等于工作完成
candidates.researchQuestion: 长期运行的数字员工在时间、资源和优先级约束下，即使语义答案看起来正确，还需要哪些证据才能把一次工作表示为真正完成？
candidates.coreProposition: 数字员工的完成状态应是一个版本化的证据向量：语义结果、必需动作、时间约束、优先级与公平义务、外部效果以及验收身份必须分别闭合；任何一个必需维度缺证都不能被高平均分覆盖。

sections.heading: One Episode Can Be Correct and Incomplete
sections.heading_zh: 同一任务可以正确又未完成

sections.heading: Improving One Dimension Does Not Fill the Others
sections.heading_zh: 改善一个维度，不会自动填满其他维度

sections.heading: Completion Is a Set of Evidence Identities
sections.heading_zh: 完成应是一组证据身份

sections.heading: A High Average Cannot Cover a Mandatory Gap
sections.heading_zh: 高平均分不能覆盖硬性缺口

sections.heading: Worker Termination Is Not Episode Closure
sections.heading_zh: 执行工作器停止不等于业务闭合

evidenceClaims.claim: The reported baseline scores Diagnosis 4.39/5, Critical Actions 2.94/5, Timeliness 3.34/5, and Disposition 4.52/5.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，基线的诊断质量为4.39/5，关键动作2.94/5，及时性3.34/5，处置4.52/5。

evidenceClaims.claim: The full configuration reports Diagnosis 4.38/5, Critical Actions 3.67/5, Timeliness 3.79/5, and Disposition 4.54/5 on the held-out batch.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，完整配置在留出批次上的诊断质量为4.38/5，关键动作3.67/5，及时性3.79/5，处置4.54/5。

evidenceClaims.claim: The evaluated harness combines trace-derived operating-manual evolution, external skills, and isolated subagents inside a continuous simulator.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究系统在持续模拟器中组合由轨迹提炼的操作手册演进、外部技能与隔离子代理。

evidenceClaims.claim: The study is simulated, uses LLM grading, and does not establish clinical safety, authorization correctness, exactly-once effects, or enterprise incident rates.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 该研究是模拟环境并使用模型评分，未建立临床安全、授权正确性、恰好一次效果或企业事故率。

evidenceClaims.claim: Semantic result, required actions, time, priority and fairness, external effects, and acceptance should remain separate completion identities.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，语义结果、必需动作、时间、优先级与公平、外部效果和验收应保持为不同完成身份。

evidenceClaims.claim: A terminal rule should require evidence closure for every mandatory dimension rather than allow score aggregation to fill a missing proof.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，终态规则应要求每个必需维度完成证据闭合，不允许综合分填补缺失证明。

evidenceClaims.claim: Enterprise thresholds, final acceptance ownership, effect reconciliation, concurrency, and retry semantics remain open.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 企业阈值、最终验收责任、效果核对、并发与重试语义仍待研究。

candidates.title: A Validated Ancestor Does Not Validate the Deployed Artifact
candidates.title_zh: 祖先通过验证，不等于部署制品已被验证
candidates.researchQuestion: 部署流程对已验证模型执行可能改变行为的转换后，安全证据应归属于已验证祖先、转换配方，还是最终真正运行的精确制品？
candidates.coreProposition: 能够改变准入相关行为的转换会产生新的证据主体；部署授权必须绑定祖先身份、精确转换、输出哈希、针对输出的验证与部署目标，血缘只能证明来源，不能自动继承行为授权。

sections.heading: Before and After Can Be Different Behavioral Subjects
sections.heading_zh: 转换前后可以表现为两种行为主体

sections.heading: Lineage Answers Origin; Validation Answers Behavior
sections.heading_zh: 血缘回答来源，验证回答行为

evidenceClaims.claim: Every reported full-precision checkpoint in the main constructed experiments has attack success rate zero for the tested backdoor behavior.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，主构造实验中的全精度检查点在测试后门行为上的攻击成功率均为零。

evidenceClaims.claim: After selected codebook quantization, every main-table model/task cell has a worst-codebook attack success rate above 0.76 and 12 of 18 exceed 0.90.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，选定码本量化后，主表所有模型与任务单元的最坏码本攻击成功率均超过0.76，18个中12个超过0.90。

evidenceClaims.claim: The attack uses structured perturbations that remain benign at full precision and produce trigger-action behavior after specific transformations.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 该攻击使用结构化扰动，使制品在全精度下表现良性，并在特定转换后产生触发动作行为。

evidenceClaims.claim: The study is bounded to deliberate attack constructions, selected models, triggers, actions, and quantization settings.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究范围限于有意攻击构造、选定模型、触发面、动作面与量化设置。

evidenceClaims.claim: A behavior-relevant transform creates a new evidence subject; lineage to an approved ancestor is provenance rather than inherited behavioral authorization.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，行为相关转换会产生新的证据主体；获批祖先的血缘是来源证明，而不是继承的行为授权。

evidenceClaims.claim: Deployment admission should bind ancestor, exact transform, output hash, output-specific validation, policy version, and deployment target.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，部署准入应绑定祖先、精确转换、输出哈希、输出特定验证、策略版本与部署目标。

evidenceClaims.claim: Transform catalogs, sufficient benign tests, equivalence proofs, chained transforms, and runtime attestation remain open.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 转换目录、充分的良性测试、等价性证明、链式转换与运行时证明仍待研究。

candidates.title: Selecting the Right Skill Does Not Grant Execution Authority
candidates.title_zh: 选对技能，不等于获得执行权
candidates.researchQuestion: 智能体运行时按需选择技能而非永久预载时，一次正确路由究竟能证明什么；在执行或宣告成功前，哪些下游事实必须继续分开？
candidates.coreProposition: 技能路由应是版本化、可归因的选择平面事件：它决定哪些技能材料进入上下文，但不能生成工具调用权限，也不能证明后续执行或业务结果成功。

evidenceClaims.claim: Gavel reaches 90.9 percent Correct-skill Trigger in the reported Qwen3-32B skill-use setting.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，Gavel 在 Qwen3-32B 技能使用设置中的正确技能触发率达到90.9%。

evidenceClaims.claim: SkillTraj contains 372 trajectories across four scenarios for routing and skill-use evaluation.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，SkillTraj 包含四种场景中的372条轨迹，用于路由与技能使用评估。

evidenceClaims.claim: The system uses a hidden-state glance, a skill bank, and explicit routing or adjudication to load skill material selectively.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 该系统使用隐藏状态观察、技能库与显式路由或裁决按需加载技能材料。

evidenceClaims.claim: Correct routing in the benchmark does not establish task completion, tool authorization, effect safety, skill quality, or exactly-once execution.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 基准中的正确路由不建立任务完成、工具授权、效果安全、技能质量或恰好一次执行。

evidenceClaims.claim: Skill routing should be an attributable selection event bound to request identity, catalog version, router evidence, and exact loaded skill versions.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，技能路由应是可归因选择事件，并绑定请求身份、目录版本、路由证据与精确加载版本。

evidenceClaims.claim: Selected skill, authorized operation, and observed outcome must remain separate facts.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，选中技能、获准操作与已观察结果必须保持为不同事实。

evidenceClaims.claim: Rapid catalog churn, adversarial descriptions, cross-role authorization, concurrent updates, and route reuse during recovery remain open.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 目录快速变化、恶意描述、跨角色授权、并发更新与恢复时路线重用仍待研究。
